suggestions: Pre-filter a large table as a CTE before the join
Reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
reached_sql:
WITH dw1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item.i_category,
           item.i_class,
           item.i_brand,
           item.i_product_name,
           date_dim.d_year,
           date_dim.d_qoy,
           date_dim.d_moy,
           store.s_store_id,
           SUM(COALESCE(store_sales.ss_sales_price * store_sales.ss_quantity, 0)) AS sumsales
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON date_dim.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN item ON item.i_item_sk = store_sales.ss_item_sk
    JOIN store ON store.s_store_sk = store_sales.ss_store_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
    GROUP BY ROLLUP(item.i_category,
                    item.i_class,
                    item.i_brand,
                    item.i_product_name,
                    date_dim.d_year,
                    date_dim.d_qoy,
                    date_dim.d_moy,
                    store.s_store_id)
)
SELECT dw2.i_category,
       dw2.i_class,
       dw2.i_brand,
       dw2.i_product_name,
       dw2.d_year,
       dw2.d_qoy,
       dw2.d_moy,
       dw2.s_store_id,
       dw2.sumsales,
       dw2.rk
FROM (
    SELECT dw1.i_category,
           dw1.i_class,
           dw1.i_brand,
           dw1.i_product_name,
           dw1.d_year,
           dw1.d_qoy,
           dw1.d_moy,
           dw1.s_store_id,
           dw1.sumsales,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dw1.i_category ORDER BY dw1.sumsales DESC) AS rk
    FROM dw1
) AS dw2
WHERE dw2.rk <= 100
ORDER BY dw2.i_category,
         dw2.i_class,
         dw2.i_brand,
         dw2.i_product_name,
         dw2.d_year,
         dw2.d_qoy,
         dw2.d_moy,
         dw2.s_store_id,
         dw2.sumsales,
         dw2.rk
LIMIT 100
